$comment: Accounted-for occurrences of the BASELINED rules in tools/private-scan.mjs - terms
that are legitimate here in specific places and private information everywhere else.
Keyed by rule + path + COUNT, not by line number, so ordinary edits above a hit do
not churn this file. The scan fails in BOTH directions: an unlisted occurrence fails,
a count that no longer matches fails, and an entry whose file no longer contains the
term at all fails as STALE. A one-way allowlist keeps passing long after the thing it
excused is gone, and then quietly excuses whatever moved into the same file.
Raising a count is a deliberate act. Say why in the entry.
